deciding.under_dosed: 269.8 L against 300 L planned is about 10% short, which is the 90% line. There is no override, and the meter and controller agree.
deciding.emitter_clogging: Pressure equals spec at 2.0 bar, valves are 100% open, and the meter and controller agree. Per-dripper delivery is low and drain sits at the bottom of the band, which fits clogging.
deciding.next_action: Normal pressure and full opening point to physical clogging, which favours repair. Nothing has been verified on site, which leaves a manual check as a defensible alternative.
deciding.drain_deviation: Mean drain is about 19.7% against a 20-30 band, only 0.3 points under. It is at the edge of the band, so level 0 or 1 are both defensible.
deciding.off_plan_cycles: Against 100 L planned, two cycles delivered 90 L, exactly 10% under and not over it. The 89.8 L cycle is 10.2% under, just over the tolerance. It counts as zero or one depending on rounding.
